title: OutputPart
description: Unified content envelope used by sessions, tasks, audit, and delegation. The building block of every output the platform emits. The spec's open-string extensibility applies to the `type` field (custom types via the `x-<vendor>/<typeName>` namespace), not to top-level keys; additionalProperties is therefore false at the root. Size-based representation (≤64KB inline, 64KB–50MB ref, >50MB rejected with 413 OUTPUTPART_TOO_LARGE) is a gateway runtime check, not a schema-validation check. See spec/15_external-api-surface.md §15.4.

schemaVersion.description: OutputPart schema revision. Consumers MUST forward-read unknown fields per the open-string evolution rule.

type.description: Open-string content type. Canonical v1 registry: text, code, reasoning_trace, citation, screenshot, image, diff, file, execution_result, error. Custom types use the `x-<vendor>/<typeName>` namespace; consumers collapse unknown types to text with annotations.originalType set.

id.description: Stable part identifier (ULID-like with `part_` prefix). Adapter-injected when omitted by the author.

inline.description: Direct content embedding. UTF-8 text for text-like types; base64 for binary types (image, screenshot, file). Mutually exclusive with `ref`.

ref.description: Blob reference for parts >64KB. Format: `lenny-blob://{tenant_id}/{session_id}/{part_id}?ttl={seconds}&enc=aes256gcm`. Mutually exclusive with `inline`.

mimeType.description: Content encoding. Type-dependent defaults (e.g., text → text/plain). Required for binary types.

annotations.description: Open metadata map. Well-known keys: role, confidence, language, final, audience, errorCode, originalType, protocolHints. Adapters index and filter on annotations.

parts.description: Nested OutputParts for compound outputs (for example, an execution_result containing code, stdout, stderr).

status.description: Delivery status. `streaming` for in-flight chunks, `complete` for fully delivered, `failed` for parts that errored mid-stream.

allOf.description: Exactly one of inline or ref must be present unless the part is a pure container (parts is non-empty and the type allows nesting, e.g., execution_result).
inline and ref are mutually exclusive.

$comment: Validation gates: inline+ref together → 400 OUTPUTPART_INLINE_REF_CONFLICT. Total size >50MB → 413 OUTPUTPART_TOO_LARGE. Annotations are advisory; unknown keys preserved.
